summary: Completed comprehensive E27 phase testing: GET /api/departures/attention (8 risk classes), POST/PATCH /api/maintenance (INV-21 enforcement), enriched /api/bookings/calendar projection, and full UI testing of Perlu Perhatian panel with risk indicators. Found 1 critical backend bug in PATCH /api/maintenance re-validation.

critical_bugs.issue: Does not re-validate INV-21 when changing start_date/end_date to clash with active booking - returns 200 instead of 400
critical_bugs.test_case: BACKEND 9a: Created maintenance with free window, then PATCHed to clash with active booking BK-0009
critical_bugs.expected: 400 with error message containing booking code
critical_bugs.actual: 200 (success) - allows maintenance window to clash with active departure
critical_bugs.impact: CRITICAL - Violates INV-21 invariant, allows double-booking of vehicles (maintenance + active departure)
critical_bugs.root_cause: PATCH endpoint calculates effective values (rec + updates) but may not be re-validating with vehicle_lock or _assert_no_departure_clash correctly

ui_bugs.issue: Day-list panel not displaying when clicking on calendar cell with events
ui_bugs.test_case: FRONTEND 21: Clicked on cell with events using selector [data-testid^='dc-cell-']:has([data-testid^='dc-event-'])
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot view day-list view of events for a specific date
ui_bugs.possible_cause: Selector timing issue or state not updating correctly after cell click

critical: Fix PATCH /api/maintenance/{id} to re-validate INV-21 when start_date/end_date are changed. The endpoint should reject (400) if the new window clashes with active bookings. Current behavior: returns 200 and allows the clash. Test case: Create maintenance with free window, then PATCH to clash with active booking - should reject but doesn't.
